components.name: Tape Strip
components.description: Signature progress strip: done, active (sliding bar), idle, fail.
components.css: .ds-tape{display:flex;width:460px;margin:0;padding:0;list-style:none;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16);border-radius:8px;background:#162032;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.35)}.ds-tape li{position:relative;flex:1;height:46px;display:flex;align-items:center;padding:0 14px;overflow:hidden;font:600 13px 'Bahnschrift SemiCondensed','Segoe UI Semibold','Arial Narrow',sans-serif;letter-spacing:.09em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#94a3b8}.ds-tape li+li{border-left:1px dashed rgba(255,255,255,.18)}.ds-tape li[data-s=done]{background:#7c3aed;color:#fff}.ds-tape li[data-s=active]{background:#a78bfa;color:#0f172a}.ds-tape li[data-s=active]::after{content:'';position:absolute;left:0;bottom:0;width:32%;height:4px;background:#0f172a;animation:ds-feed 1.1s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1) infinite}.ds-tape li[data-s=fail]{background:#f87171;color:#0f172a}@keyframes ds-feed{from{transform:translateX(-100%)}to{transform:translateX(320%)}}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-tape li[data-s=active]::after{animation:none;width:100%;height:3px}}

narrative.overview:
A dark navy desktop tool that prints a label. The page is deep navy (#0f172a), the sidebar and title bar drop one step darker (#0d1526), and everything the user works in sits on slate cards one to two steps lighter. Violet is the single brand voice: it fills the primary action, tints the active nav item, and drives the progress strip. The HTML2EXE logo (38px, 10px radius) opens the sidebar and carries the brand; nothing else in the window is decorative.

The signature is the label-tape strip. A build is a row of printed segments (queued, active, done, failed) that ends in a cut label carrying the exe name. Tape lettering is Bahnschrift SemiCondensed in uppercase, which is also the voice of every label, chip and table header. Control chrome stays ordinary: buttons, inputs, details, tables. Density is calm and tool-like; a build takes minutes, so progress, log and Cancel carry the screen.

Note on provenance: the earlier light-paper and yellow-tape look is retired. The owner asked for the original brand palette back; layout, tape strip, result label, tables and forms were kept and recolored.
keyCharacteristics: Tonal layering on navy: page, then card, then surface, with hairline white borders. No light surfaces.
One accent family: violet gradient button, violet-tint nav, violet tape.
Three type voices: Segoe UI for text, Bahnschrift caps for labels and tape, Cascadia Mono for paths and log.
Status color is saturated pastel on dark (green, amber, red) and always paired with an icon or word.
Fixed px type scale, no fluid type; one 880px content column.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Violet is the only accent. Mint, amber and coral appear only as status, never as decoration.

rules.name: The Tint Not Fill Rule
rules.body: Chips and the active nav item are a translucent tint of their color (14-16% alpha with a 40% border), never a solid fill. Solid fills are reserved for tape segments, the result strip and primary buttons.

rules.name: The Three Voices Rule
rules.body: Sentences are Segoe, stamps are Bahnschrift caps, copyable paths and logs are Cascadia. Do not mix a voice into another's job.

rules.name: The Fixed Scale Rule
rules.body: Sizes come from 12, 13, 14, 16, 20, 28 px. Intentional exceptions in the build: 15px for the logo wordmark and large buttons, 11px for the logo subtitle, 12.5px for the log.

rules.name: The Neutral Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are black, never violet, never offset-hard. Violet glow is not part of this system.

dos: **Do** build every new surface from the tonal ladder: Page Navy, Slate Card (#1e293b), Deep Slate (#162032), Raised Slate (#263248), separated by hairline borders.
**Do** keep violet as the only accent; primary buttons use the violet gradient with white text and the neutral Lift shadow.
**Do** put 12px radius on panels, 8px on controls, 6px on chips and small buttons, 4px on tiny tags.
**Do** set stamps (section labels, chips, table heads, tape) in Bahnschrift SemiCondensed uppercase with 0.07-0.12em tracking; set paths and logs in Cascadia Mono.
**Do** show state with the tape vocabulary: done is Deep Violet, active is Lilac with the sliding bar, fail is Coral.
**Do** pair every status color with an icon or word, and honor reduced motion.
donts: **Don't** reintroduce the light paper surfaces, yellow tape or black-tape button of the retired look.
**Don't** add a second accent hue, or use mint, amber and coral for anything other than status.
**Don't** use violet glows, hard offset shadows, or shadows other than the three in the vocabulary.
**Don't** replace the drawn stroke icons (1.75 stroke on a 24px grid) with glyphs or emoji.
**Don't** pad the layout with stat-card dashboards or multi-page wizards; one column, one primary action.
**Don't** use solid fills for chips or the active nav item; tint them.
